collection.description: Visitors teach an unfamiliar dance at a village gathering.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Visitors teach an unfamiliar dance at a village gathering.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The dancers stumble and laugh together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One villager masters the rhythm surprisingly quickly.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The visitors invite the watchers to join when ready.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The lessons turn into a playful argument about tempo.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A new tradition begins in the clearing.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The mixed dance is too complicated, so everyone simplifies it.
